title: Model calls
description: Calling a model through the hub (docs/extensions/extensions.md "Model calls", #6102): model.complete, with the permission models in the manifest's permissions.hub, granted by the user. The call runs on the extension's own purpose extension.<id> in Settings › Model configuration, which follows "Knowledge base" until the user picks another model for it; the extension never sees a key or chooses the connection. There is no budget and no cap: each call's usage comes back in its result, and the hub logs it. A connection held for quota or load (model_paused) sends nothing until it lets go. Params are strict: an unknown field is invalid_params. Plugin-side: only the hub and the program speak it.

ModelErrorCode.description: error.code of model.complete besides permission_denied (data {scope: "models"}): invalid_params; assistant_offline (the manager is away: try again); model_unavailable (nothing to call for this extension: the user picks a model for it in Settings › Model configuration); model_paused (the connection is held for quota or load, nothing was sent; data ModelPause: try again after until); model_failed (the upstream failed the request: an error status or a dropped connection); model_refused (the model declined to answer this input, a refusal or a content filter: sending it again unchanged gets the same answer, so split it, drop a part or report it; data ModelRefusal); timeout (past timeout_seconds); invalid_output (with json_schema, the reply was still not JSON matching it after one more try; data ModelInvalidOutput).

ModelMessage.description: One turn of the conversation: the user's, or the model's earlier answer.

ModelCompleteParams.description: model.complete (models): one answer to a conversation that starts and ends with the user's turn, the turns alternating.

max_tokens.description: Room for the answer; 0 is 4096. Connections speaking the Responses API are sent none.

json_schema.description: A JSON Schema the answer must match: the hub asks for JSON matching it, checks the reply (type, enum, const, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, prefixItems, lengths, bounds, allOf / anyOf / oneOf, local $ref) and asks once more when it does not match; the result's json has the decoded value. At most 64 KiB.

timeout_seconds.description: Bounds the whole call, a second try included; 0 is 120.

label.description: What the call is for (daily, weekly…): it goes in the hub's log line with the usage.

ModelUsage.description: What the call spent, every request of it together (a second try for json_schema included), as the upstream counted it.

text.description: The answer as the model wrote it.

json.description: With json_schema: the answer decoded, matching it.

stop_reason.description: end_turn, or max_tokens when the answer was cut off.

ModelInvalidOutput.description: The data of invalid_output: why the last reply did not match, the reply, and what the call spent.

ModelRefusal.description: The data of model_refused: what the upstream said and what the declined call spent.

stop_reason.description: The upstream's reason: refusal (a refusal stop or part) or content_filter.
